optimized_sql:
SELECT MIN(bn.name) AS member_in_charnamed_movie
FROM (
    SELECT n.id, n.name
    FROM name AS n
    WHERE n.name LIKE '%B%'
) AS bn
JOIN cast_info AS ci ON ci.person_id = bn.id
JOIN (
    SELECT mc.movie_id
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
    JOIN (
        SELECT mk.movie_id
        FROM movie_keyword AS mk
        WHERE mk.keyword_id = (SELECT k.id FROM keyword AS k WHERE k.keyword = 'character-name-in-title')
    ) AS km ON km.movie_id = mc.movie_id
) AS fm ON fm.movie_id = ci.movie_id
JOIN title AS t ON t.id = fm.movie_id
